stem:
A student makes the model shown with objects representing the sun, Earth, and the moon to use in a class demonstration.

Which action should the student do with the objects to demonstrate a complete day-night cycle of Earth?

options.label: F
options.text: Move the moon around Earth once

options.label: G
options.text: Spin the sun in a circle once

options.label: H
options.text: Move Earth around the sun once

options.label: J
options.text: Spin Earth in a circle once

visual_elements: Light arrows from sun to Earth
